reviews.comment: One of the worst instructors I've had. Her essay instructions are vague, yet she grades harshly without offering feedback. She expects high levels of participation & gets annoyed when students don't contribute how she wants. She's very passive aggressive. The workload is overwhelming, reading 4 full novels in one semester on top of assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Do NOT take this woman if you want an easy A for an English credit. She is a harsh grader, doesn't put out a rubric, expects us to understand what she's thinking, is late to class every time, takes years to grade things, and is not a nice person overall. I feel like I'm wasting my time learning from her.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I enjoyed this class, but I like reading. We read 4 books, a few short stories, and a few poems too. The books we read were actually really good, which made homework (reading) easy for me. If you don't like reading, I promise you, there are much more boring ENG classes you can take than 306. Sometimes assingment directions were unclear.

AWFUL. She might be the worst prof i've had ever, she is late to class every single day, she provides little to no feedback, extremely hard grader, and gives NO instructions for any of the assignments. I can not say enough bad things about this prof or this class, DO NOT RECOMMEND!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She is late to class, did not post class on canvas till 2nd day of class Constantly reading different books prob 10+ a semester. Give no clear instructions, the occasional times she lectures they make no sense Most class periods are spent talking about the book and she expects everyone to have an opinion and share it, for the whole hour and 15 mins

Absolutely confusing when trying to reach out to her. Class discussions are confusing, gets upset when no one speaks even though no question was asked to the class. Everyone got lower grades due to her canvas showing the wrong word amount needed, we just need to be able to know that it was above the max word amount that was shown.

Please avoid taking this professor if possible. She does not take even the slightest amount criticism well and reacts impulsively and immaturely. Although she is passionate about the subject, she is not a good professor. This class has always been treated like an afterthought, taking an upwards of 2 months to grade one paper (500 words)

Professor Nandi is clearly knowledgeable about what she teaches. However, there has been a severe communication issue on her part all year. She expects you to read her mind when it comes to her expectations, and proceeds to be angry if you do not meet them. Her feedback is lacking and passive aggressive. was 5-15 mins late to class 99% of the time.

Her class is sometimes disorganized and discussions occasionally awkward, but she clearly wants her students to learn and does her best to teach. She can be hard to reach outside of class. Overall nice, but needs some development as a prof.

Her class was straight forward in design, though assignment details were sometimes vague until the last minute. Professor Nandi could use some development in teaching efficiency and grading speed, but if you learn through discussion, her classes will work well for you. She is a very nice person, even if she comes off stressed sometimes.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I do NOT recommend this prof. I loved all of the course materials, but I found myself stressed so much just bc of how this professor taught and how she talked to her students. She was always passive aggressive, would go back on her word and the syllabus, and when she made mistakes she blamed her students. Thank god at the end she didn't grade harsh
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Essays had vague directions with no rubric. Process with how our assignments were graded is questionable and feedback didn't make sense. Pretty judgmental during class discussions. When the class reached out about concerns, she apologized but blamed it on us for "misunderstanding". She was frequently late. Didn't respond to any of my emails.
Limited feedback on assignments and incredibly limited direction/guidelines established.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This professor is incredibly unorganized, stressful and taught me nothing. She is always late to class, hardly gives any feedback on assignments and gives little/no explanation for grades received. She has expectations she does not convey to her students and gets frustrated when they are not met. Thankfully, she was generous with grades.
